package parents

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"github.com/viant/bindly/resource"
	"github.com/viant/datly/bootstrap"
	gateway "github.com/viant/datly/gateway/http"
	"github.com/viant/datly/internal/testharness/sqlite"
	"github.com/viant/datly/mcp"
	druntime "github.com/viant/datly/runtime"
	"github.com/viant/datly/spec"
	dsql "github.com/viant/datly/sql"
	"github.com/viant/mcp-protocol/schema"
	"github.com/viant/sqlx/testutil/sqlfault"
)

type holderLoader struct {
	load func(context.Context) (*druntime.RegisteredComponent, error)
}

func (l holderLoader) LoadComponent(ctx context.Context, _ spec.Key) (*druntime.RegisteredComponent, error) {
	return l.load(ctx)
}

func TestHiddenRelationHTTPMCP(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"eager", "indexed"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx := context.Background()
			h := sqlite.New(t)
			require.NoError(t, h.ExecStatements(ctx,
				"CREATE TABLE parents(id INTEGER, name TEXT)", "INSERT INTO parents VALUES(1,'parent'),(2,'empty')",
				"CREATE TABLE timeline(parent_id INTEGER, value INTEGER)", "INSERT INTO timeline VALUES(1,11),(1,22),(9,999)",
				"CREATE TABLE summaries(parent_id INTEGER, value INTEGER)", "INSERT INTO summaries VALUES(1,7),(9,999)"))
			var childReads atomic.Int32
			db := h.FaultDB(t, func(_ context.Context, call sqlfault.Call) error {
				if call.Phase == "query" && (strings.Contains(call.SQL, "FROM timeline") || strings.Contains(call.SQL, "FROM summaries")) {
					childReads.Add(1)
				}
				return nil
			})
			const pkg = "github.com/viant/datly/relationtagsfixture/parents"
			resources := resource.New()
			for namespace, fs := range bootstrap.LinkedResources(nil, pkg) {
				require.NoError(t, resources.Register(namespace, fs))
			}
			cwd, err := os.Getwd()
			require.NoError(t, err)
			sources, err := bootstrap.DiscoverComponentsFromPackages(ctx, filepath.Dir(cwd), []string{pkg}, nil)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Len(t, sources, 1)
			component, err := sources[0].Resolve(reflect.TypeFor[ParentsInput](), reflect.TypeFor[ParentsOutput]())
			require.NoError(t, err)
			loader := holderLoader{load: func(ctx context.Context) (*druntime.RegisteredComponent, error) {
				artifact, err := bootstrap.BuildArtifact(bootstrap.ArtifactInput{Component: component,
					InputType: reflect.TypeFor[ParentsInput](), OutputType: reflect.TypeFor[ParentsOutput](), Resources: resources})
				if err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
				reader, err := artifact.ReaderCompilation().NewExecution(bootstrap.ReaderRuntimeConfig{SQL: &dsql.SQLComponent{DB: db}})
				if err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
				return artifact.Registration(druntime.RegisteredComponent{Reader: reader})
			}}
			var rt *druntime.Runtime
			config := mcp.Config{}
			if mode == "indexed" {
				rt, err = druntime.NewIndexedRuntime([]*spec.Component{component}, nil, loader)
				config.Indexed, config.Loader = []*spec.Component{component}, rt
			} else {
				registered, loadErr := loader.load(ctx)
				require.NoError(t, loadErr)
				config.Components = []*druntime.RegisteredComponent{registered}
				rt, err = druntime.NewRuntime(config.Components)
			}
			require.NoError(t, err)
			t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, rt.Shutdown(context.Background())) })
			config.Invoker = rt
			service, err := mcp.New(config)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.NoError(t, service.PrepareTool(ctx, "Parents"))
			tool, ok := service.Registry().ToolRegistry.Get("Parents")
			require.True(t, ok)
			require.NotNil(t, tool.Metadata.OutputSchema)
			encodedSchema, err := json.Marshal(tool.Metadata.OutputSchema)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			for _, hidden := range []string{"privateTimeline", "privateSummary", "PrivateTimeline", "PrivateSummary"} {
				require.NotContains(t, string(encodedSchema), `"`+hidden+`"`)
			}
			http := gateway.NewHandler(rt, nil, "test")
			for _, tc := range []struct {
				name            string
				id              int
				fields          []string
				computed, reads int
			}{
				{"populated", 1, nil, 40, 2},
				{"empty", 2, nil, 0, 2},
				{"projected enrichment", 1, []string{"id", "computed", "PrivateTimeline", "PrivateSummary"}, 40, 2},
				{"unselected relations", 1, []string{"id"}, 0, 0},
			} {
				t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
					args := map[string]any{"id": tc.id}
					query := url.Values{"id": {jsonNumber(tc.id)}}
					if tc.fields != nil {
						args["fields"] = tc.fields
						query["fields"] = tc.fields
					}
					childReads.Store(0)
					res := httptest.NewRecorder()
					http.ServeHTTP(res, httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/parents?"+query.Encode(), nil))
					require.Equal(t, 200, res.Code, res.Body.String())
					require.EqualValues(t, tc.reads, childReads.Load())
					assertHiddenRow(t, res.Body.Bytes(), tc.computed, tc.name == "unselected relations")
					childReads.Store(0)
					result, rpcErr := tool.Handler(ctx, &schema.CallToolRequest{Method: schema.MethodToolsCall, Params: schema.CallToolRequestParams{Name: "Parents", Arguments: args}})
					require.Nil(t, rpcErr)
					require.True(t, result.IsError == nil || !*result.IsError)
					require.EqualValues(t, tc.reads, childReads.Load())
					encoded, err := json.Marshal(result.StructuredContent)
					require.NoError(t, err)
					assertHiddenRow(t, encoded, tc.computed, tc.name == "unselected relations")
				})
			}
		})
	}
}

func jsonNumber(v int) string { b, _ := json.Marshal(v); return string(b) }

func assertHiddenRow(t *testing.T, data []byte, computed int, idOnly bool) {
	t.Helper()
	var result struct {
		Data []map[string]any `json:"data"`
	}
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(data, &result))
	require.Len(t, result.Data, 1)
	row := result.Data[0]
	for _, name := range []string{"privateTimeline", "privateSummary", "PrivateTimeline", "PrivateSummary"} {
		require.NotContains(t, row, name)
	}
	if idOnly {
		require.Len(t, row, 1)
	} else {
		require.EqualValues(t, computed, row["computed"])
	}
}
